Summary: The risen Christ's charge to Peter: if you love me, feed my lambs, tend my sheep, feed my sheep. Drafted on its merits with its scope stated: addressed to Peter in his restoration, and read by many as the pattern for all pastoral care.
Commandment: Feed my lambs; tend my sheep; feed my sheep.
Application: Three times asked, three times charged — Peter's denial is undone by a commission. Whether the charge belongs to Peter alone as apostle or extends as the pattern of all shepherding is debated, and this row does not settle it.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: love for Christ is proved by feeding his flock (John 21:15-17).
